answer_prose: Only 1 city met both-period sample requirements near the faster standard. Among those close finishes, 51.3% were at or below it in 2016–2017 and 58.8% in 2019. This narrow comparison cannot establish that the qualifying-rule change altered pacing.
detail_prose: This initial analysis focuses on ages 18–31 in 2016–2017 and 2019; it does not assign individual Boston eligibility or acceptance.
